instruction: Demonstrate to me how to remove Freeform from the Dock
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to set dockItems to name of every UI element of list 1 of application process "Dock"' 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq "(Freeform|无边记|المساحة الحرة|フリーボード)" && echo "False" || echo "True"
